party.text:
SEPARATE MODE / BETA · LIMITED TIME

Puffer Party.
Pass it on.

A separate multiplayer category game on Krillion. Give a valid answer, pass the puffer and avoid being the player holding it when it bursts. The last surviving player wins.

Open official Puffer Party

Official entry and rules checked 2026-11-01.

01
Answer, then pass the puffer.

Name something that fits the current question before the puffer bursts on you. Follow the room’s countdown; the Daily Dive’s 25-second rule does not define this mode.

02
Keep answers fresh within the question.

An answer already used for the current question cannot be reused. Listen to the other players and prepare another valid choice.

03
Rarity can help you survive.

Rarer answers move you closer to an extra heart. The official landing rules do not publish a fixed heart threshold or promise a heart for every rare answer.

The official page offers rated matchmaking, unrated Quick Play, hosting, joining by code and a public room list. Choose the entry that suits your group and check its current availability.

The homepage labels this a limited-time beta. Its availability and rules may change. ZowGame explains the official entry screen and rules; play, matchmaking and rooms stay on krillion.io.

Daily Dive remains the seven-question solo daily run. Its preset score tiers, 700-point maximum and depth calculator are separate from Puffer Party.
